items.title: The Shared Umbrella Stand
items.topic: students improving a shared umbrella stand near the school entrance
items.action: added numbered spaces and simple name tags
items.benefit: students could find their umbrellas more quickly after school
items.challenge: wet tags sometimes became difficult to read
items.lesson: a useful system should work even in the conditions where it is needed
items.detail: the group covered the tags with clear waterproof sleeves
items.reflection: Hana learned to test an idea in real conditions before calling it finished
items.topicJa: 学校玄関の共用傘立てを生徒が改善する活動
items.benefitJa: 放課後に自分の傘をより早く見つけられること
items.challengeJa: 濡れた名札が読みにくくなること
items.lessonJa: 仕組みは実際に使う環境でも機能するか確かめる必要がある

items.title: A Better Lost-and-Found Box
items.topic: students reorganizing a school lost-and-found box
items.action: separated items into small labeled sections
items.benefit: owners could search for missing items without emptying the whole box
items.challenge: new kinds of items did not always fit the original categories
items.lesson: simple categories should be flexible enough for unexpected cases
items.detail: the team added an other-items section and reviewed it each Friday
items.reflection: Sota learned that organization improves when a system can change
items.titleJa: 忘れ物箱を使いやすく
items.topicJa: 学校の忘れ物箱を整理し直す活動
items.benefitJa: 箱全体を出さなくても失くした物を探しやすくなること
items.challengeJa: 最初の分類に当てはまらない物もあったこと
items.lessonJa: 分類の仕組みには予想外の物にも対応できる柔軟さが必要

items.title: The Hallway Plant Team
items.topic: a class organizing care for plants placed along a sunny hallway
items.action: made a weekly watering chart and checked the soil before watering
items.benefit: the plants received more regular care without being watered too much
items.challenge: different plants needed different amounts of water
items.lesson: a shared routine works better when it allows for important differences
items.detail: students added small care cards beside each pot
items.reflection: Mei learned that equal treatment is not always the same as proper care
items.topicJa: 日当たりのよい廊下の植物をクラスで世話する活動
items.benefitJa: 水のやり過ぎを防ぎながら定期的に世話できること
items.challengeJa: 植物によって必要な水の量が違うこと
items.lessonJa: 共通の手順にも大切な違いへ対応する工夫が必要

items.title: Signs for the Recycling Corner
items.topic: students making clearer signs for a school recycling corner
items.action: used short words and pictures to show where each item belonged
items.benefit: fewer bottles and papers were placed in the wrong containers
items.challenge: some packages were made from several materials
items.lesson: clear instructions should also explain what to do when the answer is not obvious
items.detail: the class added a small tray for uncertain items to be checked later
items.reflection: Kenta learned that good guidance includes a plan for difficult cases
items.titleJa: リサイクルコーナーの表示
items.topicJa: 学校の分別場所の表示を分かりやすくする活動
items.benefitJa: ペットボトルや紙が違う箱に入ることを減らせること
items.challengeJa: 複数の素材でできた包装は分け方が分かりにくいこと
items.lessonJa: 分かりやすい案内には判断が難しい場合の対応も必要
